name: سرشت‌ها
roots: سرشت (seresht, from سرشتن, to knead: the make a being is kneaded of); نهاد (nahād, what is laid at the foundation); طبیعت (tabī'at) is left to physis, the philosophers' nature, which is not this

name: جسم
roots: جسم (jesm, Arabic: bulk; Ibn Sina: a substance in which three dimensions may be posited); تن (tan, Middle Persian: the living body); کالبد (kālbad: the frame, the mould)

name: گفتنی
roots: گفتن (goftan, to say); معنا (ma'nā: meaning, the Arabic philosophers' nearest word for λεκτόν); اعتباری (e'tebārī: Tabatabai's posited beings — ownership, contract, office — which are by being placed in an order people keep)

name: سرشت
roots: سرشتن (to knead: the make a being is of)

name: گونه
roots: گونه (gune, Middle Persian gōnag: colour, sort); جنس (jens, Arabic: genus); تیره (tire: a lineage)

name: گونه‌ها
roots: گونه (gune: a sort, a kind)

name: رشته‌ها
roots: رشته (reshte, from رشتن, to spin: a thread, a strand)

name: چارچوب
roots: چار (four) + چوب (wood): the four timbers that hold a thing

name: ماده
roots: م-د-د (to extend, to supply); the operator's word: an organisation of atoms makes ماده

name: گرانش
roots: گران (gerān: heavy — and dear, costly); گرانش (the Persian Academy's word for gravitation)

name: حیات
roots: ح-ي-ي (to live) — the operator's word; زیستن (zistan: to live)

name: نطق
roots: ن-ط-ق (to speak: نطق is speech and reason at once — the philosophers' حیوان ناطق, the speaking animal, for ζῷον λόγον ἔχον); عقل (aql: reason, first a tether)

name: ساخته‌ها
roots: ساختن (sākhtan: to make, to build)

name: شرایط
roots: ش-ر-ط (a condition: شرط, first a mark, a sign)

name: اعتدال
roots: ع-د-ل (to be even, just — عدل, justice); اعتدال المزاج (Ibn Sina: the balance of a mixture that readies it for a soul)

name: تناسب
roots: ن-س-ب (to relate: نسبت, a ratio, a relation)

name: قواعد بنیاد
roots: قاعده (qā'ede, ق-ع-د, to sit: a base, and a rule); بنیاد (foundation)

name: وزن
roots: و-ز-ن (to weigh: میزان, a balance, a measure) — the operator's word; سنگینی (heaviness)

name: مراتب اجسام
roots: مرتبه (martabe, ر-ت-ب: a step one stands firm on); پیچیدگی (pichidegi, from پیچیدن, to twist together); مراتب وجود (the philosophers' grades of being), here of bodies alone

name: فضا∞زمان
roots: فضا (fazā: an open expanse); زمان (zamān) — the operator's form, one thing seen from two sides

name: ذره‌ی بنیادی
roots: ذره (zarre, Arabic ḏarra: a mote in a sunbeam); بنیاد (bonyād: the foundation); نقطه (noqte: the dot, undivided)

name: هادرون
roots: ἁδρός (stout); کوارک (quark)

name: هسته
roots: هسته (haste: the stone of a fruit, the kernel)

name: اتم
roots: ἄτομος (uncut); جزء لایتجزا (the part that is not divided, of the kalām); جوهر فرد (jowhar-e fard: the single substance)

name: مولکول
roots: moles (a mass); مولکول (a little mass)

name: یاخته
roots: یاخته (the Persian Academy's word); سلول (cellule, from cella: a little room)

name: بافت
roots: بافتن (bāftan, to weave)

name: اندام
roots: اندام (andām, Middle Persian handām: a limb, a member; also stature, form); عضو (ʿozv, Arabic: a member)

name: دستگاه
roots: دستگاه (dastgāh: dast, the hand + gāh, a place: means gathered at hand; also a mode of Persian music, in which many melodies work as one)

name: جاندار
roots: جان (jān: life, soul) + داشتن (to hold): a being that holds a life; موجود زنده (a living being)

name: جمعیت
roots: ج-م-ع (to gather): a gathering of one kind

name: جامعه‌ی زیستی
roots: جامعه (jāme'e, ج-م-ع: what gathers); زیستن (zistan, to live)

name: زیست‌بوم
roots: زیست (life) + بوم (bum: the ground one lives on, a homeland)

name: زیست‌کره
roots: زیست (life) + کره (kore: a sphere)

name: نطق
roots: ن-ط-ق (to speak: نطق is speech and reason at once — the philosophers' حیوان ناطق, the speaking animal, for ζῷον λόγον ἔχον); عقل (aql: reason, first a tether)

name: جنس
roots: جنس (jens: the stuff a thing is of — what is it made of?); ماده (the line it is on)

name: سنگ
roots: سنگ (sang, Middle Persian: stone); صخره (sakhre, Arabic: a rock)

name: جرم آسمانی
roots: جرم (jerm, Arabic: a body, a bulk — the astronomers' word); آسمان (āsmān, Avestan asman: stone, and the sky — once thought a vault of stone)

name: سامانه‌ی سیاره‌ای
roots: سیاره (sayyāre, س-ي-ر, to travel: the wanderer); سامانه (a system)

name: کهکشان
roots: کاه (straw) + کشان (trailing): the trail of spilled straw across the sky

name: قطعه
roots: ق-ط-ع (to cut: a piece cut to fit); ساختن (to make)

name: افزاره
roots: افزار (afzār, Middle Persian abzār: an instrument, a means); the Persian Academy's word for a device

name: تأسیسات
roots: أ-س-س (a foundation: اساس)

name: تاج
roots: تاج (tāj, Middle Persian tāg: a crown); افسر (afsar: a diadem)

name: واجب الوجود
roots: و-ج-ب (to fall due, to be necessary) + وجود (being, و-ج-د: to find — being is what is found); ابن سینا: واجب الوجود بالذات, necessary by itself, beside ممکن الوجود, possible in itself and necessary only through another

name: مهر
roots: مهر (mehr, Avestan miθra: the covenant, the bond — and love, and the sun, which gives life); عشق (eshq: longing love)

name: خرد
roots: خرد (kherad, Middle Persian xrad: wisdom, reason); Ferdowsi opens the Shahnameh: به نام خداوند جان و خرد — in the name of the Lord of life and wisdom; حکمت (hekmat)

name: به‌واسطه‌ی
roots: واسطه (vāsete, Arabic wāsiṭa, و-س-ط: what stands in the middle, an intermediary); واسطه‌ی فیض (the philosophers' intermediary through whom being flows)

name: وضعیت
roots: و-ض-ع (to lay down, to place); حال (hāl: a state)

name: ابعاد
roots: بُعد (bo'd, ب-ع-د: to be far — a dimension is a way of being far); اندازه (andāze: a measure)

name: زمان
roots: زمان (zamān, Middle Persian: a time, a span; Avestan zrvan, time itself) — which Arabic took from Persian

name: درازا
roots: دراز (derāz: long); طول (tūl, Arabic)

name: کِی
roots: کی (kei: when); متی (matā: the category of when, in the philosophers' Arabic)

name: کجا
roots: کجا (kojā: where); أین (ayn: the category of where); جای (jāy: a place)

name: مکمل‌ها
roots: ک-م-ل (to be whole); نیمه‌ی دیگر (the other half)

name: بیان‌شده
roots: بیان (bayān, ب-ي-ن: to make distinct, clear)

name: حامل
roots: ح-م-ل (to carry); دارنده (dārande: the holder)

name: سامانه
roots: سامان (sāmān: order, good arrangement) — the Persian Academy's word for a system; نظام (nezām)

name: بخش‌بندی
roots: بخشیدن (bakhshidan: to share out — and, the same verb, to give and to forgive); نقطه (noqte: the dot)

name: بخش‌بندی‌ها
roots: بخشیدن (to share out)

name: جزءِ
roots: جزء (joz', Arabic: a part); کل (kol: the whole); پاره (pāre: a piece)

name: ساکنِ
roots: س-ک-ن (to be still, to dwell); زیستگاه (zistgāh: the place of living, a habitat)

name: واقع در
roots: و-ق-ع (to fall, to befall: where a thing has come to lie); جای (jāy: a place)

name: مالک
roots: م-ل-ک (to possess, to rule: مُلک, a realm; مَلِک, a king); از آنِ (belonging to)

name: پاسخ‌گو
roots: پاسخ (pāsokh: an answer) + گفتن (to say); مسئول (mas'ul, س-ا-ل: the one who will be asked)

name: به دست آمده از
roots: دست (dast: the hand): what came to hand, and from whom; خرید (kharid: a purchase)

name: وجوه پاسخ‌گویی
roots: وجه (vajh: a face, an aspect); پاسخ (an answer)

name: حقوقی
roots: حق (haqq: a right, and truth)

name: فنی
roots: فن (fann: a craft, an art)

name: تجربه
roots: ج-ر-ب (to try, to test)

name: مالی
roots: مال (māl: wealth, what one has)

name: کنش‌ها
roots: کنش (konesh, from کردن, to do)

name: ساخته
roots: ساختن (sākhtan: to make, to build — and to suit, to agree)

name: برگرفته
roots: برگرفتن (to take from); مشتق (moshtaq, ش-ق-ق: split off)

name: خوانده
roots: خواندن (khāndan: to read — and to call, and to sing)

name: گفته
roots: گفتن (goftan: to say)

name: خاستگاه
roots: خاستن (khāstan: to rise) + گاه (a place): where a word rose; اسناد (esnād: the chain of those who handed a report on, each named)

name: لایه‌ها
roots: لایه (lāye: a layer, a fold)

name: مرام‌نامه
roots: مرام (marām, ر-و-م: what is sought) + نامه (a writing)

name: قانون
roots: κανών (a straight rod, a rule — through Arabic qānūn); داد (dād, Middle Persian: law, justice)

name: چرایی
roots: چرا (cherā: why); استدلال (estedlāl, د-ل-ل: seeking what points the way)

name: روزنامه
roots: روز (a day) + نامه (a writing): the daybook; دفتر (daftar: a book of record — from διφθέρα, a prepared hide: the name this language carries)

name: تاریخ
roots: أ-ر-خ (to date: a dating); پیشینه (pishine: what came before)

name: صف
roots: ص-ف-ف (to stand in a row); نوبت (nowbat: a turn); معلق (mo'allaq: hanging, undecided)

name: نام‌ها
roots: نام (nām, Old Persian nāman); واژه‌نامه (vāzhe-nāme: a book of words)

name: نما
roots: نمودن (namudan: to show, to appear); نما (a view in a drawing: an elevation, a facade)

name: عدسی‌ها
roots: عدس (adas: a lentil) — the same image

name: آشنایی
roots: آشنا (āshnā: the known one, a friend); جهت‌یابی (finding one's direction)

name: دریافت
roots: دریافتن (daryāftan: to find within, to grasp); فهم (fahm)

name: بهره‌برداری
roots: بهره (a yield) + برداشتن (to take up): the running of a working plant

name: وارسی
roots: وارسیدن (vārasidan: to reach into, to examine)

name: باغ
roots: باغ (bāgh); پردیس (pardis, Avestan pairi-daēza: walled around — the garden that gave the world paradise)

name: نام
roots: نام (nām)
